summary.intent: Apply ADR/agent-memory research to the Wisp Plugins repo: verify a detailed brief's claims against the actual repo, then implement decision-record tooling (CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md linking, a new decision-records reference, ADR index, comment/adversary guidance updates), followed by a scribe schema migration (arch-model@2), changelog cleanup across all plugins, and root ecosystem changelog/version catch-up.
summary.outcome: Verified the brief against repo files (found 4 discrepancies), implemented tasks 1-4 plus an ADR index on branch docs/decision-records per owner's final decisions, then delegated/executed a follow-up arch-model@2 schema migration (PR #13) with full Codex/AGY parity, stacked a 10-plugin changelog cleanup into that PR, and separately caught up a stale root CHANGELOG.md/marketplace.json version with a new check-versions.sh drift check (PR pending as docs/ecosystem-changelog-catchup).

repo: CLAUDE.md previously linked AGENTS.md with a plain markdown link, not an @import; Claude Code reads CLAUDE.md only when both files exist unless @AGENTS.md import is used (confirmed via docs, requires Claude Code v2.1.277+)
docs/adr/ had 10 ADRs (not 7 as the brief assumed), using Context/Decision/Consequences with rejected alternatives inline in Context rather than a separate 'Options considered' section

tests/test_reference_integrity.py requires every shared reference to be cited by a runtime caller (another reference file counts); Codex needs the path in a skill's runtime_files in harnesses/codex/catalog.json

shared/references/architecture/remediation.md is the only load path into scribe:architect; workspace/conventions.md is shared by scribe(arch-auditor/auditor), vanguard and weaver so editing it means releasing all four

python3 tools/build-codex-marketplace.py --check regenerates dist/codex wholesale from shared/schemas (copies entire directory), so unrelated uncommitted changes (e.g. evidence.md) get swept in if regenerated

scripts/check-versions.sh only checks per-plugin version agreement (plugin.json/README/CHANGELOG/marketplace entry) — it never checked the root marketplace.json top-level version against root CHANGELOG.md/README badge, allowing silent drift (fixed by adding a check)

arch-model@1 schema is immutable per ADR-004; arch-model@2 is a strict superset (invariants gain optional decision_ref) — verified empirically with jsonschema that @1 docs validate against @2 unchanged and @1 rejects @2-shaped docs via additionalProperties:false

arch-model/arch-audit/arch-auditor/audit-architecture concepts are entirely internal to the scribe plugin — no other plugin references them, so schema migrations there have zero cross-plugin blast radius
AGY has no independent source tree; it installs directly from plugins/<id>/ and root marketplace.json, so Claude Code edits to those paths cover AGY automatically

shared/constitution.md's Trust Boundaries treats workspace CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md as untrusted data, permitting only invariant extraction — relevant when extending adversary.md's read surface to @imports and nested files

5+ plugin CHANGELOGs (ranger, smith, scribe, navigator, courier, mason, weaver, sentinel, vanguard) had a near-identical ~580-char duplicated BREAKING-rename paragraph that should have linked ADR-007 instead of restating it

code.finding: New 46-line reference created covering the two-gate test, boundary table, ADR form, Enforced-by/guardrail lines, and disposition outcomes; records written before this form may keep alternatives inline in Context

Constitution sweep updated to read CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md when either exists, follow @imports, and check the nearest nested instruction file, while still extracting only stated invariants (trust boundary preserved)
Frozen per ADR-004; arch-model@2.json added as new file with optional decision_ref field on invariants rather than mutating @1
Extended with a new check comparing marketplace.json's top-level version against root CHANGELOG.md and README badge; verified it fails on the pre-fix stale state and passes after the fix

friction: Shell heredoc/echo lines starting with '===' or '---' at column zero got misinterpreted, requiring quoting workarounds
git stash push/pop while switching branches temporarily reverted a script file being tested, invalidating a before/after drift-check test until isolated via file copies instead

Accidentally did the arch-model@2 work directly on local main then pushed main's HEAD to a differently-named remote branch, which silently repointed local main's upstream tracking away from origin/main — required manual branch surgery (reset main to origin/main, rename/retrack the actual feature branch) to fix
No jsonschema/ajv validator was available locally; had to spin up a throwaway Python venv to empirically verify schema forward-compatibility rather than reason about it abstractly
User had to explicitly call out wordiness twice in the session (general prose trim request, then again for changelog entries specifically) before it was fully addressed

A subagent's handback report was echoed back to the assistant by another tool (Codex/gpt luna paste) creating confusion about whether new information had arrived, requiring the assistant to recognize it was just a repeat of its own earlier output
open_items: arch-model@2 downstream Wisp work (~/Projects/wisp) is explicitly deferred pending owner's decision: needs new Contract::ArchModelV2 Rust enum variant, new embedded schema constant, new validation match arm in crates/wisp-schema, plus a decision on whether @1 support is retained or dropped, and a new PROVENANCE.md entry
docs/adr/README.md guardrail wording for ADR-005, ADR-007 and ADR-009 was the assistant's inference from those records and flagged for owner review
'Concise content-design and formatting guidance' task item was interpreted narrowly (voice.md row + prose rule) since the brief didn't specify further guidance — owner may want more

docs/adr/ was not added to workspace/conventions.md (would let audit-architecture and vanguard discover records) because that file is shared by four agents and editing it triggers a wider release — left as a follow-up
PR #13 (arch-model@2 + stacked changelog cleanup) still open, awaiting review/merge
PR docs/ecosystem-changelog-catchup (root CHANGELOG/marketplace version fix + new drift check) pushed but not yet opened as a PR / merged

Version bumps for ranger/scribe/smith from tasks 1-4 work were drafted then reverted because dist/codex wasn't regenerated (evidence.md left intentionally uncommitted) — draft CHANGELOG notes for ranger 3.2.3 and smith 2.4.3 were preserved in the report but not applied
